verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's docs confirm on-call scheduling exists (schedule-basics doc on mapping coverage needs, escalation policies connecting to schedules) but the evidence pack never explicitly documents rotation layers, time-zone handling, or round-robin coverage mechanics that the story specifically asks about. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-layer schedules, time-zone-aware rotations, round-robin assignment logic, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these work as advertised.
